title: Cold-start priming playbook — scratch
content:
Context:
This is a personal scratchpad for eliciting a pragmatic "cold-start" priming playbook we can prototype in the next infra sprint. Goal: reduce 95p cold-response latency for low-traffic tenants by applying lightweight priming (no dedicated warm pools) while preserving cost and isolation principles for Dedicated/Private customers.

High-level ideas / primitives to explore:
- async shallow prewarm: issue a short (N tokens) prime request to populate KV cache + kernel JIT traces for model variants that share architecture.
- speculative batching: create pooled mini-batches from ephemeral priming requests so they hit continuous-batching paths without blocking steady-state traffic.
- model-lite priming: use a smaller quantized/adapter variant for priming then seamlessly route to full model on live requests (fallback if mismatch).
- affinity hints: tag tenant requests with locality+recent-variant to prioritize priming on nodes with likely cache hits.

Architectural sketch (ASCII):

  ingress --> prewarm-orchestrator --> (1) probe-cache (2) enqueue-speculative-batch --> serving-runtime
                                  |                             ^
                                  +--> telemetry-store ----------+

Observations: priming can touch two state surfaces: KV cache (per-key) and runtime hot paths (kernels/JIT). We should treat them separately.

API shape sketches (for internal priming controller):
- POST /internal/v1/priming/start
  payload: {"tenant_id":"t_123","model":"redwood-v2-7b","variant_hint":"int8-slim","mode":"shallow","budget_ms":150} 
  response: {"job_id":"pj_234","status":"accepted"}

- GET /internal/v1/priming/status?job_id=pj_234
  response: {"job_id":"pj_234","state":"running|done|failed","metrics":["kv_hits","tokens_generated","latency_p50"]}

Config sketch (yaml-like) — per-tenant defaults and overrides:
priming:
  enabled: true
  shallow_probe_tokens: 24
  speculative_batch_size: 8
  max_budget_ms: 200
  preferred_variant: "int8-slim"
  policy: "on-demand|scheduled|always-on"

Experiment matrix (quick wins first):
1) Shallow probe only: issue 24-token probe on first post after idle for 60s — measure 95p reduction.
2) Speculative batch pooling: pool priming probes across tenants for 100ms windows to reach batch size 6. Compare cost/token vs no pooling.
3) Model-lite priming: prime with int8-slim then route to full model; evaluate hallucination/regression risk on 2eval prompts.
4) Affinity hint test: set node-locality hint from last successful route and measure cache hit delta.

Metrics to capture:
- cold_latency_95 (ms) pre/post
- priming_cost_per_hour (USD) per-tenant
- % of primed requests that see KV-hit on first live request
- failed_priming_rate (timeouts, OOMs)
- regression-rate-on-evalset (quality drift)

Open questions / risks:
- Safety: priming involves generating model tokens; for sensitive tenants ensure prompts are sanitized and do not leak PII or system instructions.
- Billing: how do we bill for priming compute vs normal requests? Likely absorbed under warmup budget for Dedicated and usage for Hosted. Need billing policy.
- Cross-tenant pooling: privacy implications if pooling across tenants to reach batch sizes. Consider per-tenant pools and cross-tenant only for public/shared workloads.
- Cache eviction pressure: priming might evict useful context for busy tenants. We need eviction heuristics (LRU with tenant-weighting).

Short run plan (next 6 weeks):
- week 0: implement /internal priming API + lightweight orchestrator stub (no pooling) — feature-flagged.
- week 1–2: run shallow-probe experiments on small cohort (10 tenants) with telemetry.
- week 3: add speculative-batch pooling (configurable) and variant-hint plumbing.
- week 4: evaluate perf & cost, iterate policies, write short recommendations doc for product.

Notes to self:
- Keep priming footprint tiny (<200ms per priming job).
- Default to non-blocking: priming never delays client request; it only accelerates subsequent calls.
- Add explicit opt-out per-tenant.

References / related pages: see linked artifacts above; also check GH PR #4120 (speculative batching) for pairing runtime changes.

Todo (short):
- [ ] Draft billing proposal with finance (Priya)
- [ ] Add explicit prompt sanitizer hook in priming pipeline
- [ ] Prototype probe with int8-slim variant and collect evalset metrics

End of scratch.
